name: Watchful Wasp
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level sorcerer/wizard 5, cleric 5, druid 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a bit of paper and a needle)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Duration 1 hour/caster level or until discharged, then 1 round/caster level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

As mage’s faithful hound, except you conjure a giant wasp that buzzes loudly if any Small or larger creature approaches within 30 ft. of it. Instead of a bite, the wasp delivers a wicked sting (+6 attack bonus, 1d8+6 points of piercing damage, plus poison). The watchful wasp’s poison is equivalent to that of a giant wasp:

Type poison (injury); save Fortitude DC 18; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Dex; cure 1 save.
